typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	BEGIN_DT as timestamp (),
	Email_Recipients as string (),
	END_DT as timestamp (),
	FileName as string (),
	GRGR_CK as string (),
	InboundPath as string (),
	Inbound_PregnancyConfig_File as string (),
	OutputPath as string (),
	PregnancyConfig_FileName as string (),
	RowCount_Eligibility as integer (),
	Select_Query as string (),
	SendToSameSkyOutbound as string (),
	STARTDT as timestamp ()
}

source(output(
		HRA_ID as string,
		CONCEPT_ID as string,
		FORM_ID as string,
		Active as string,
		AreaAffected as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> GetPregnancyConfig
GetPregnancyConfig derive(c_HRA_ID = toLong(HRA_ID),
		c_Active = Active,
		c_CONCEPT_ID = toLong(CONCEPT_ID),
		c_AreaAffected = AreaAffected,
		c_FORM_ID = toLong(FORM_ID)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion sink(input(
		Active as boolean,
		CONCEPT_ID as integer,
		HRA_ID as integer,
		FORM_ID as integer,
		AreaAffected as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		Active = c_Active,
		CONCEPT_ID = c_CONCEPT_ID,
		HRA_ID = c_HRA_ID,
		FORM_ID = c_FORM_ID,
		AreaAffected = c_AreaAffected)) ~> LoaddatatoSameSkyPregnancyConfig
